title: ui scripts vitest: date-only-zone-pins-10183 fails after a test that writes process.env.TZ without restoring it (isolate false order dependence)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found by the #36363 thread (PR #36437) in its local gate run on 2026-11-22. Filed by the seat.

## What happens

The ui `scripts/` vitest project runs with `isolate: false`. `ui/scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` fails 2 cases when it runs after a test file that writes `process.env.TZ` and does not restore it (the thread names `vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts` as the likely writer). Run alone, the same file passes 39 of 39. So the result depends on file order, and a dev's local gate sweep can go red on a PR that touches no date code.

## What should happen

Every test in that project that writes `process.env.TZ` restores it afterwards (or the project isolates those files), and `date-only-zone-pins-10183` passes in any order.

## Done when

- The `scripts/` project passes twice in a row with a shuffled file order (`--sequence.shuffle`).
- A pin or lint rule stops a new unrestored `process.env.TZ` write in that project.
